description: This file defines constants, types, and functions for handling and formatting sizes in human-readable formats, including conversions between size strings and byte counts, supporting SI and binary units.

methods.name: getSizeAndUnit
methods.description: Calculates the size and corresponding unit string for a given size, base, and unit map.

methods.name: CustomSize
methods.description: Returns a human-readable approximation of a size using a custom format.

methods.name: HumanSizeWithPrecision
methods.description: Returns a human-readable size string with specified precision.

methods.name: HumanSize
methods.description: Returns a human-readable size string with default precision.

methods.name: BytesSize
methods.description: Returns a human-readable size string in bytes or binary units.

methods.name: FromHumanSize
methods.description: Parses a size string in SI units into an integer byte count.

methods.name: RAMInBytes
methods.description: Parses a human-readable RAM size string into bytes, supporting binary units.

methods.name: parseSize
methods.description: Parses a size string with units into an integer byte count, handling suffix validation.
